patterns.short_summary: Task stages that were previously carried out in distinct tools, windows, or databases are placed inside one environment where they share state.
A free-form conversational channel is live at the same time as a non-conversational artifact the user is attending to, and the turns are about that artifact.

The same content is made available under two different presentation or interaction disciplines, and a selection determines which is in force.
